observation: CONFIRMED (OBSERVED_CURRENT): the font uploaded and renamed earlier in this run ('QA CTX-20260910-05 Hey Magnolia', id 920) DOES appear in the artwork editor's Custom Fonts picker for a text ('Paragraph') layer, alongside the other 3 existing custom fonts on this store (QA Renamed Baginda, Bebas Neue, Dear Sans_Condensed Regular). The picker dialog is visually/functionally identical to the /fonts page (heading 'Your Custom Fonts', 'Upload fonts' button, Search box, preview-size slider, same warning banner about unsupported characters, per-card Download/Delete icons) plus an extra 'Select' action per card not present on /fonts. This confirms custom fonts uploaded via Assets > Upload Fonts are directly usable as the Font family of a text layer in the artwork editor (Font type = Custom Fonts), without needing a Font Category or Font-type layer. No Save was clicked; the Google Fonts -> Custom Fonts toggle on this layer was left as unsaved editor session state and discarded via Cancel (see act notes) per editor.md ('Thêm/sửa config layer đều gọi 0 API cho tới khi Save & Close').
